# Vahhab Piranfar

> Molecular microbiologist and computational researcher working on antimicrobial resistance (AMR), antibiotic PK/PD modeling, bacterial modeling, and reproducible evidence synthesis. Based in Jersey City, New Jersey, USA. EB-1A recipient.

Website: https://vahhabpiranfar.com/
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3653-5739
Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=o2GdH2oAAAAJ&hl=en
GitHub: https://github.com/piranfar
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vahhab-piranfar/

## Focus

- Antimicrobial resistance and bacterial adaptation
- Antibiotic PK/PD and pharmacometric simulation (virtual populations, PTA/CFR, Monte Carlo)
- Provenance-aware evidence-composite modeling for fragmented antimicrobial evidence
- Clinical microbiology and molecular diagnostics

## Selected research (sole author unless noted)

- Rifampicin tolerance classification is bounded by assay detection floor among clinical Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates — SSRN, under review — https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7533152
- Implications of Ceftazidime-Avibactam Clearance Correlation for Target Selection and Single-Analyte TDM — Research Square, under review — https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-10713786/v1
- Comparative modeling of antibiotic resistance, tolerance, and persistence in Mycobacterium tuberculosis and Staphylococcus aureus — bioRxiv preprint — https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.02.12.637810
